# OCA Watersports

> OCA Watersports is a jet ski and pontoon boat rental company located at 12817 Harbor Rd, Ocean City, Maryland 21842. Founded in 2010 (formerly Under The Bridge Watersports), OCA operates the Famous 6 Mile Ride — a 6-mile southbound jet ski route from the Ocean City inlet to the Verrazano Bridge along Assateague Island National Seashore. Phone: 410-629-RIDE (7433). Email: ride@ocawatersports.com. Rating: 4.4 stars, 640+ Google reviews.

## Services

- [Jet Ski Rentals](https://www.ocawatersports.com/jet-skis.html): Sea-Doo GTX jet ski rentals, $129+tax per ski, 70-minute rides, 1-3 riders per ski, 450 lb max, minimum age 16 to operate, minimum age 21 to rent without guardian.
- [Pontoon Boat Rentals](https://www.ocawatersports.com/pontoon-boats.html): Private pontoon boat rentals for up to 12 guests. 1hr/$199, 2hr/$329, 3hr/$419 +tax. You drive — temporary boater's license issued at dock. Access to Assateague Island bay-side sandbars, Seacrets, and the entire OC bay.
- [The 6 Mile Ride](https://www.ocawatersports.com/the-6-mile-ride.html): OCA's signature jet ski experience — 6 miles south from the OC Inlet to the Verrazano Bridge along Assateague Island National Seashore. Wild horses, dolphins, sandbars, 37 miles of protected coastline.
- [Boats & Jet Skis For Sale](https://www.ocawatersports.com/for-sale.html): Rental fleet units for sale. 2026 Sea-Doo GTX Pro 130 w/ iBR ($9,400-$10,500, MSRP $17,999), 2022-2024 GTX Pro 130 skis ($3,400-$6,500, available now), and 2024-2025 Berkshire 24RFX LE 2.75 tritoons with Mercury 115hp ($37,990-$39,990). Serviced prior to sale. Ask for Cliff.

## Key Facts

- Location: 12817 Harbor Rd, Ocean City, MD 21842 (north side of Rt. 50 drawbridge, direct bay access, next to The Angler restaurant)
- Jet ski price: $129+tax per ski, 70 minutes of ride time, Sea-Doo GTX, up to 3 riders per ski, 450 lb max
- Pontoon price: $199 (1hr), $329 (2hr), $419 (3hr) +tax, 100% private, up to 12 guests, 1,900-2,100 lb max
- Add-ons: Bluetooth speaker $50, Fishing package $39, Crabbing package $39, Tube $75
- Jet ski speed: 40-42 mph on open water
- Reviews: 4.4 stars, 640+ Google reviews
- Founded: 2010 as Under The Bridge Watersports; rebranded to OCA Watersports
- Route: 6-mile southbound only, no guided tour, riders operate independently after safety briefing
- Assateague Island: 37-mile barrier island, National Seashore protected by NPS since 1965, wild horses roaming since the 1600s

## Blog (Question-and-Answer Guides)

The OCA blog answers the most common questions visitors ask about jet ski and pontoon boat rentals in Ocean City, MD. Each post is original content written by the OCA team and includes a direct-answer summary, structured FAQ, and links to relevant booking pages.

- [How to See Wild Horses on Assateague Island from the Water](https://www.ocawatersports.com/blog/wild-horses-assateague-island-ocean-city-md.html): Guide to seeing the Assateague Island wild horses from a jet ski or pontoon, including viewing zones, etiquette, and federal 50-yard distance rules.
- [Jet Ski vs Pontoon Boat: Which OCA Rental is Right for Your Group?](https://www.ocawatersports.com/blog/jet-ski-vs-pontoon-ocean-city-md.html): Side-by-side comparison of jet ski vs pontoon rentals at OCA: capacity, duration, pricing, age requirements, best use cases.
- [Best Things to Do on the Water in Ocean City, Maryland](https://www.ocawatersports.com/blog/things-to-do-on-water-ocean-city-maryland.html): Overview of on-the-water activities in Ocean City: jet skiing, pontoon cruising, sandbar hopping, wildlife watching, the 6 Mile Ride.
- [Where to See Dolphins in Ocean City MD (From the Water)](https://www.ocawatersports.com/blog/where-to-see-dolphins-ocean-city-md.html): The 4 best spots to see bottlenose dolphins in Ocean City, MD: the inlet, nearshore Atlantic, bay-side Assateague, and Sinepuxent Bay. Includes time-of-day and tide notes.
- [Best Sandbars in the Ocean City MD Bay: A Pontoon Boat Guide](https://www.ocawatersports.com/blog/best-sandbars-ocean-city-md-pontoon-guide.html): Where to find the best sandbars in the OC bay for pontoon trips, with tide timing, anchoring instructions, and packing list.
- [What to Bring on a Jet Ski Rental in Ocean City: Complete Packing List](https://www.ocawatersports.com/blog/what-to-bring-jet-ski-rental-ocean-city-md.html): What to wear, what to leave in the car, what OCA provides, and the gear upgrades worth making before a jet ski rental.
- [The Ultimate Ocean City MD Bachelorette Boat Rental Guide](https://www.ocawatersports.com/blog/ocean-city-md-bachelorette-boat-rental-guide.html): Bachelorette weekend playbook on the water: private 12-guest pontoons, 4-hour itinerary template, Seacrets stop, sandbars, drinking laws, jet ski add-ons.
- [Best Time of Day to Rent a Jet Ski in Ocean City MD](https://www.ocawatersports.com/blog/best-time-of-day-jet-ski-ocean-city-md.html): Morning vs mid-day vs afternoon vs sunset jet ski slots compared on water conditions, wildlife, crowds, and price. Includes day-of-week recommendations.
